description: This file contains a test class for the LDAP synchronization service, specifically testing the deletion of local users who are no longer present in the LDAP server. It extends KernelTestCase and includes setup, multiple test scenarios, and helper methods for creating LDAP entries and mocking collection behaviors.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceDeleteUsersTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying LDAP user synchronization and deletion of obsolete users.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the fixture directory path before each test.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Tests deletion of local users who are removed from the LDAP server.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Tests deletion behavior when duplicate usernames exist within LDAP entries.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Tests deletion when some LDAP entries are missing required attributes, simulating failed LDAP fetch scenarios.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Creates a mock EntryCollection object from LDAP entries and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Generates a list of LDAP Entry objects based on provided usernames.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Creates LDAP entries with duplicate usernames to test handling of duplicates.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Creates LDAP entries missing required attributes to test how failed imports are handled.
